classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume reads each class_a file once per unit under the broadcast `budget_ns`, abandoning the rest (`if budget_ns and probe.NS() - started > budget_ns: return staged, True`), so the read must fit a time window; per the writer/reader rule only the consumer rank is waiting on its own read.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops `for _pass in range(CLASS_B_READS)` doing plain probe.read_staged with no budget check, so the consumer rank simply stalls on each of the 8 reads of a given file while other ranks are only writing their own data.
